<p class="is-style-t-overline"><strong>In this end-of-year release we’re introducing:</strong></p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><em><em>Review Insights that leverage LLMs to surface reviewers’ sentiment on common aspects of a business, offering a shortcut to the information in reviews you care about most.</em></em></li>



<li><em><em>Enhanced business discovery with more personalized content on the home feed and trending searches, as well as refreshed business pages that now surface reviewers’ Recognitions alongside their reviews, display the business’s tipping policies, provide easier ways to quickly connect with businesses, and more.</em></em></li>



<li><em><em>More functionality and availability for Yelp Assistant, our AI chatbot that connects you with pros, along with easy project editing and broadcasting to streamline communication with pros.</em></em></li>



<li><em>Request a Quote in Apple Maps, enabling seamless connections with local pros no matter where you’re searching from.</em></li>



<li><em>AI-powered smart selection for advertisers, which automatically optimizes and strengthens ad performance, and a refreshed AI-enhanced business owner inbox to help service pros better manage their leads.</em></li>
</ul>



<hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity">



<p>This year, Yelp celebrated <a href="https://blog.yelp.com/news/yelp-20th-anniversary/">20 years</a>! From our <a href="https://www.yelp.com/biz/kabuki-springs-and-spa-san-francisco-2?hrid=c6HT44PKCaXqzN_BdgKPCw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://www.yelp.com/biz/kabuki-springs-and-spa-san-francisco-2?hrid=c6HT44PKCaXqzN_BdgKPCw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">first review</a> to hundreds of millions of contributions, we’ve grown with our community, always keeping the same mission in mind: helping you connect with great local businesses, whether it’s discovering your new favorite restaurant or finding a service pro who can quickly handle an emergency fix in your home.</p>



<p>Today, we’re excited to unveil our end-of-year product release, featuring more than 20 new features and updates designed to enhance the Yelp experience for both consumers and business owners. This release includes new AI-powered Review Insights to help you seamlessly find the right business for your needs, a more personalized home feed to help you discover new local gems, more information on a business’s tipping policies so you know what to expect before you get there, enhancements to Yelp Assistant to simplify how you find the right service pro for your project, and more. For business owners, we’re excited to introduce AI-powered features that automatically optimize ads and simplify lead management—helping them attract more high-intent customers and streamline their operations.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-introducing-ai-powered-review-insights-your-shortcut-to-the-information-you-care-about-most"><strong>Introducing AI-powered Review Insights: Your shortcut to the information you care about most</strong></h2>


<div class="wp-block-image">
<figure class="alignright size-full is-resized"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="856" height="1778" src="https://blog.yelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/GIF-of-Review-Insights.gif" alt="New Review Insights use large language models (LLMs) to analyze and summarize reviewer sentiment on various aspects of a business, such as food quality, service, and ambiance. Insights are displayed above a business’s reviews as aggregated sentiment scores for each topic—positive, neutral, and critical—ranging from 1 to 100. Users can also explore related reviews for each topic. Review Insights are available on iOS for restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses." class="wp-image-788283" style="width:318px;height:auto"></figure></div>


<p>When searching for a local restaurant, you might have a specific aspect in mind that matters most to you—be it the vibe of the space, how long it takes to get a table, or the quality of the food. While Yelp is known for aggregating consumer reviews of local businesses into a single business rating, we know finding detailed information about your specific interests can be time-consuming. To streamline this process, we’re introducing Review Insights, which leverage large language models (LLMs) to discern reviewer sentiment for common aspects of a business, such as the quality of its food, service, ambiance, wait time, and drinks. Even when a review doesn’t explicitly mention one of the topics, the LLM understands the context in the review to identify and surface the relevant topic and sentiment.</p>



<p>Review insights are surfaced as aggregated sentiment scores—positive, neutral, and critical—ranging from 1 to 100 for each topic, conveniently displayed above reviews on business pages. By tapping on these scores, you can delve into all the reviews related to a specific topic you care about, gaining a clearer picture of the firsthand experiences. Currently available on iOS for restaurant, food, and nightlife businesses, we plan to expand Review Insights to services categories next year.</p>

<p><span style="font-weight: 400">Initially released for restaurants, food, and nightlife categories earlier this year, Recognitions now highlight even more categories reviewers are passionate about across more than 220 additional home services, beauty, and active life categories. New attributes include:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400"><span style="font-weight: 400">Whether the business has a “no tipping” policy, if tipping is optional, or if gratuity is automatically applied to the bill, for restaurant, food, nightlife, and beauty services businesses.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400"><span style="font-weight: 400">If tipping is mandatory or optional for large parties for restaurant, food, nightlife, and event services businesses.</span></li>

</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400">You can find these attributes under the “Payments” section within the business’s amenities on their Yelp page. Business owners can add these attributes for free by logging into their </span><a href="https://business.yelp.com/" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://business.yelp.com/', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;"><span style="font-weight: 400">Yelp for Business account</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400"> and editing their “Business Information” section. 				<p><span style="font-weight: 400">Testing different ads to determine what resonates best with consumers can be time-consuming and require marketing expertise. To simplify this process, we’re introducing smart selection, an AI-powered feature for advertisers that automatically tests the best reviews and photos to showcase, optimizing their ad for the highest return on ad spend. When advertisers select “smart selection” during ad setup, Yelp will select, test, and optimize an ideal review and photo to help maximize the number of users it drives to their Yelp page, increasing their reach, and helping them meet their advertising goals. This free feature is available to all advertisers.</span></p>
			</div>

		<button class="c-accordion__header h5" aria-controls="accordion-content-681dacf4f0d63" id="accordion-header-681dacf4f0d64" aria-expanded="false" aria-selected="false" role="tab">
					<span class="c-accordion__header-container">
						Unlocking competitive insights and enhancing support 					</span>
		</button>
		</h3>
		<div class="c-accordion__content" id="accordion-content-681dacf4f0d63" aria-labelledby="accordion-header-681dacf4f0d64" hidden="true" aria-hidden="true" role="tabpanel">
			<div class="c-accordion__content-container t-sink s-sink" data-depth="0" data-autop="true">
				<p><span style="font-weight: 400">We’re adding new options for competitive insights and support for local businesses with new features designed to simplify their advertising choices. Business owners looking to better understand how their page performance compares to others now have access to more customizable competitive data. The new page views dashboard in their business owner account enables them to compare their page views with up to three competitors of their choice in one view, helping to inform their own growth strategies. For advertisers who see significant fluctuations in their business due to seasonality, we’re introducing new ad budget options that allow them to temporarily reduce their ad spend during seasonal shifts with automatic restarts whenever it’s most convenient for them. Finally, our </span><a href="https://biz.yelp.com/support-center" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://biz.yelp.com/support-center', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;"><span style="font-weight: 400">redesigned Support Center</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400"> now features refreshed content tailored to businesses’ advertising status, simplifying how they find answers to their questions, underscoring our commitment to supporting business success with helpful resources. </span></p>

  function external_links_in_new_windows_loop() {
    if (!document.links) {
      document.links = document.getElementsByTagName('a');
    }
    var change_link = false;
    var force = '';
    var ignore = '';

    for (var t=0; t<document.links.length; t++) {
      var all_links = document.links[t];
      change_link = false;
      
      if(document.links[t].hasAttribute('onClick') == false) {
        // forced if the address starts with http (or also https), but does not link to the current domain
        if(all_links.href.search(/^http/) != -1 && all_links.href.search('blog.yelp.com') == -1 && all_links.href.search(/^#/) == -1) {
          // console.log('Changed ' + all_links.href);
          change_link = true;
        }
          
        if(force != '' && all_links.href.search(force) != -1) {
          // forced
          // console.log('force ' + all_links.href);
          change_link = true;
        }
        
        if(ignore != '' && all_links.href.search(ignore) != -1) {
          // console.log('ignore ' + all_links.href);
          // ignored
          change_link = false;
        }

        if(change_link == true) {
          // console.log('Changed ' + all_links.href);
          document.links[t].setAttribute('onClick', 'javascript:window.open(\'' + all_links.href.replace(/'/g, '') + '\', \'_blank\', \'noopener\'); return false;');
          document.links[t].removeAttribute('target');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function external_links_in_new_windows_load(func)
  {  
    var oldonload = window.onload;
    if (typeof window.onload != 'function'){
      window.onload = func;
    } else {
      window.onload = function(){
        oldonload();
        func();
      }
    }
  }

  external_links_in_new_windows_load(external_links_in_new_windows_loop);

<h1 class="page-title h1 c-subheader-post__title">
	Yelp survey findings reveal consumers favor detailed, genuine reviews over AI-generated or biased content</h1>

			
<p class="c-subheader-post__lead-in">
	88% of review readers believe AI-generated reviews shouldn’t be allowed on review platforms</p>

			<hr>

			
<div class="c-subheader-post__authors ">

		<article class="item-single">

			<div class="item-single__content s-sink t-sink l-sink l-sink--double">
				
<p>At Yelp, we understand the significant influence online reviews have on people’s purchasing decisions, which is why we take <a href="https://trust.yelp.com/trust-and-safety-report" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://trust.yelp.com/trust-and-safety-report', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">extensive measures</a> to maintain reliable and helpful content on our platform, putting consumer trust at the center of everything we do. To further understand what makes online reviews helpful and trustworthy, we partnered with <a href="https://today.yougov.com/" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://today.yougov.com/', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">YouGov</a> to survey over <strong>2,350</strong> review readers—individuals who’ve ever used online reviews of local businesses to guide their purchase decisions—uncovering valuable insights into consumer expectations and behaviors regarding local businesses and their reviews.</p>



<p>The survey reveals that consumers value authenticity and quality in online reviews, preferring detailed, firsthand experiences over just star ratings. As reliance on reviews increases, people favor platforms that highlight genuine insights and prevent AI-generated, compensated, or incentivized reviews. Our commitment to these principles aligns with consumer expectations, helping us <a href="https://blog.yelp.com/news/academic-research-finds-yelps-content-moderation-practices-mitigate-misinformation-and-build-consumer-trust/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">maintain trust</a> and reliability in the review landscape.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-consumers-prefer-detailed-reviews-from-a-variety-of-perspectives"><strong>Consumers prefer detailed reviews from a variety of perspectives</strong></h3>



<p>When making important spending decisions, whether for a <a href="https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=Special+Dinner" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=Special+Dinner', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">special dining experience</a> or <a href="https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=Kitchen+Remodel" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=Kitchen+Remodel', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">hiring a professional for a kitchen remodel</a>, people often rely on others’ recommendations. In fact, <strong>72%</strong> of review readers say they read more online reviews now than ever before to guide their local business purchase decisions.</p>



<p>Even as influencer reviews on social media become more prevalent, <strong>88%</strong> of review readers still prefer seeing multiple opinions on review platforms over individual ones on social media. Aggregated feedback on review platforms often provides a more accurate and comprehensive prediction of what to expect from a local business, allowing people to more easily <a href="https://blog.yelp.com/news/end-of-year-product-release-2024/#:~:text=Introducing%20AI%2Dpowered%20Review%20Insights%3A%20Your%20shortcut%20to%20the%20information%20you%20care%20about%20most" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">discover feedback on specific topics</a> about a business that matter most to them.</p>



<p>So what do consumers find most helpful when researching the right business? They value review text that reflects genuine, firsthand customer experiences—not simplistic rating systems. Indeed, <strong>71%</strong> of review readers don’t consider a star rating without written text to be a review at all, and <strong>88%</strong> are more likely to trust reviews with written text over just a star rating. </p>



<p>This underscores the importance of Yelp’s policy to require review text with every star rating. However, not all review platforms take the same approach, for instance, Google allows star ratings without text. <a href="https://deveshraval.github.io/reviews.pdf" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://deveshraval.github.io/reviews.pdf', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Research from FTC Economist Devesh Raval</a> found approximately 50% of Google reviews contain fewer than 100 characters, including 32% lacking text entirely. In contrast, the same research found that only 2% of Yelp reviews had less than 100 characters. As of December 31, 2024, the <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/4?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/4?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">average length of recommended reviews contributed to Yelp was about 447 characters</a>. Consumers seek more than just a star rating—they want detailed experiences and insights from customers, which is why our guidelines emphasize quality over quantity.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-consumers-want-reviews-written-by-actual-customers-not-ai"><strong>Consumers want reviews written by actual customers—not AI</strong></h3>



<p>Despite the rise of AI tools, <strong>88%</strong> of review readers oppose AI-generated reviews on review platforms. This aligns with <a href="https://www.yelp.com/guidelines" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://www.yelp.com/guidelines', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">our policies</a> at Yelp, as we require all reviews to be based on genuine, firsthand experiences with a business, and reviewers must write their own reviews. Since 2023, we’ve rolled out several <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/5?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/5?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">new detection technologies</a> powered by AI to help identify and mitigate AI-generated reviews, and we continue to enhance these efforts.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-consumers-don-t-tolerate-compensated-and-incentivized-reviews"><strong>Consumers don’t tolerate compensated and incentivized reviews</strong></h3>



<p>Reviews sought in exchange for compensation or other incentives aim to mislead consumers. People strongly want review platforms to moderate these deceptive practices and disclose them when uncovered. The survey found that <strong>91%</strong> of review readers want platforms to disclose if a business has ever been the subject of suspicious review activity or other attempts to deceive consumers. Additionally, <strong>83%</strong> of review readers would avoid a business if they learned it had fake or compensated reviews.</p>



<p>In September 2024, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) <a href="https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">issued a final rule</a> banning fake and incentivized reviews. At Yelp, we not only align with this rule, but our policies go even further to address additional deceptive behaviors, such as <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/9?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/9?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">prohibiting compensated and incentivized reviews</a> altogether, <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/13?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/13?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">attempts to suppress critical reviews</a>, and more. For over a decade, our <a href="https://trust.yelp.com/consumer-alerts/" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://trust.yelp.com/consumer-alerts/', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Consumer Alerts program</a> has warned people when we find evidence of extreme attempts to manipulate ratings and reviews.</p>



<p>Today, we’re introducing a <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/8?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/8?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Consumer Alerts History section</a> on Yelp business pages that previously received <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/9?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/9?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Compensated Activity Alerts</a>, <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/9?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/9?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Suspicious Review Activity Alerts</a>, or <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/13?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/13?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Questionable Legal Threat Alerts</a>. This new section, along with our existing <a href="https://trust.yelp.com/consumer-alerts/quarterly-alerts/" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://trust.yelp.com/consumer-alerts/quarterly-alerts/', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">index of Compensated and Suspicious Review Activity Alerts</a> on our <a href="https://trust.yelp.com/" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://trust.yelp.com/', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Trust & Safety site</a>, ​​offers another way for people to learn about abnormal review activity or prior attempts to mislead them.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image alignwide size-large"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="2416" height="691" src="https://blog.yelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Consumer-alerts-2416x691.jpg" alt="" class="wp-image-788567"></figure>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-consumers-want-relevant-reviews-about-customer-experiences-not-current-events"><strong>Consumers want relevant reviews about customer experiences, not current events</strong></h3>



<p>In an era marked by viral news and opinions spreading online at lightning speed, when a business gains public attention, we often see people flock to Yelp to share their opinions on the matter. However, such content can mislead other consumers and harm businesses, which is why it’s important to prevent and moderate reviews not based on genuine firsthand experiences with the business. In fact, <strong>94%</strong> of review readers agree that reviews should reflect actual customer experiences, not what someone saw on the news or social media. </p>



<p>We address these incidents through our broader <a href="https://trust.yelp.com/consumer-alerts/" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://trust.yelp.com/consumer-alerts/', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Consumer Alerts program</a>. When our systems detect unusual spikes in activity, our User Operations team may investigate and, if necessary, temporarily disable the ability to post reviews while placing one of our <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/11?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/11?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">Media Attention Alerts</a> on the business’s Yelp page. Once activity decreases, we clean up the business page so that its reviews reflect firsthand consumer experiences. In 2024, <a href="https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/11?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI" rel="noreferrer noopener" onclick="javascript:window.open('https://issuu.com/yelp10/docs/2024_yelp_trust_safety_report/11?fr=sYTdjNTgyMTUzMDI', '_blank', 'noopener'); return false;">920 total Media Attention Alerts were placed on business pages</a>, resulting in the removal of over 56,900 reviews.</p>



<p>As the review landscape evolves, we remain committed to maintaining the integrity and quality of content on our platform. How does Yelp use Generative AI?

Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) content on Yelp is generated via OpenAI. AI content at Yelp may be trained on Yelp platform content, like reviews, or on training sets provided through third party services, like GPT-4.

We are constantly working to improve the Yelp experience, and our use of AI, to provide you with helpful information. That said, AI is a rapidly evolving technology and may sometimes include inaccurate information.

Does Yelp allow posting reviews generated by AI software?

Any reviews created with AI software violate Yelp’s Content Guidelines, as reviewers must write their own reviews based on their own direct firsthand consumer experiences at businesses. Use of chatbots or other AI tools to create reviews, including using such tools to draft or revise, are subject to removal and repeated violations may result in account closure, per our Terms of Service. Please visit our Content Guidelines and Trust & Safety sites to learn more about how Yelp moderates content.

	text-align: left;

.article #content ol {
	list-style: decimal;
